name: Medivh
shortDescription: The Guardian of Tirisfal whose corruption and contact with Gul'dan enabled the Dark Portal and the invasion of Azeroth.
body: Original interpretive fan art shows Medivh holding the full Atiesh staff: a dark gnarled shaft crowned by an integrated carved seated raven with hooked beak and folded wings, a violet eye detail, and the mage version’s hanging red streamer. The same staff-bearing figure is used wherever Medivh appears in story playback. Its exact silhouette and treatment remain subject to human comparison against the relevant Classic/TBC client model.
